questions.q: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

questions.q: Which of the following is not a possessive determiner?

questions.q:
In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.

To who (1)/did you (2)/speak last night? (3)/No error (4)
questions.s:
Here the correct answer is 1.
Key Points:-

  • In the above given sentence, the error is in part 1.
  • It is so because instead of 'who' here we will just use 'whom'.
  • One easy way to find out what to use is that If the question can be answered with 'he/she', the question must be asked with 'who'.
  • But if the answer involves 'him/her', question must be asked with 'whom'. 
  • Here we can't say 'I was speaking with he'.
  • Rather 'I was speaking with him' is correct.
  • Therefore, 'who' will be replaced by 'whom'.

Thus, the correct sentence is To whom did you speak last night.

o: any doubts you may
have about the project.
questions.s: Objective case comes after ‘let’, ‘like’, ‘between…..and’, ‘but’, ‘expect’, and ‘all prepositions’. According to this rule, the given sentence is correct.

questions.s: The sentence is grammatically correct. 'Among' is correctly used for more than two people.

questions.q: The culture of Japan is fascinating, especially when compared to China.
o: The culture of Japan is
questions.s:
‘That’ (is singular) is used for a distant thing/person. ‘Those’ (is plural) is used for more than one distant thing/person.

The correct answer would be: “The culture of Japan is fascinating, especially when compared to that of China.”
